description:
Find STOCKS by an options-behaviour pattern (opana lens) across the ~557 US optionable names — returns
    ranked UNDERLYINGS each with a plain-language `because` + `metrics` (value, and prev→delta for a trend/flip).
    STOCK scanner only: it does NOT pick option contracts/strikes/expiries (for one named stock's detail use
    `options_sentiment`). The `pattern` is a key OR plain English (the server resolves it) — its `temporal_mode`
    decides the read (level = now, rising/falling = ~2-week trend, flip = reversal). A `supported:'no'`/`'future'` pattern returns an empty
    list + an honest note (say so, don't substitute). US-capped — state that in the answer.

horizon.description: `short` | `long` — which options horizon to read (default long = the positioning/conviction lens; short = the gamma/near-term lens).
horizon.title: Horizon

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, hard cap 50). Keep SMALL + narrow the scope; page/refine rather than dump — heavily-covered assets have hundreds of articles.
limit.title: Limit

min_strength.description: Optional cutoff on the ranked axis / Δ — omit to let the scanner return the top-ranked names.
min_strength.title: Min Strength

pattern.description: An options-behaviour pattern — an exact key OR plain English ('cheap implied vol', 'crowd getting fearful', 'smart money piling in'); the server resolves it. CSV = AND-combine (intersect), e.g. 'iv_cheap,smart money buying'; the FIRST token owns the ranking. 🔴 ENGLISH.
pattern.title: Pattern

name: options_scan
title: Options Scan
